question: By what means can a mortal be freed from one kind of sin?
premises: Sin has more than one kind.
A mortal can be freed from one of them.
Expiation and concentration are named as means.
inference: One kind of sin can be removed through expiation and concentration.
uncertainties: Which of the two kinds this refers to is implied but not explicitly labeled here.
plain_english: A mortal is freed from one kind of sin by expiation and by concentration.
